title: The advantages of the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) over F1 score and accuracy in binary classification evaluation
study_context: Binary-classification evaluation using illustrative and genomics examples.
population_or_data: Binary-classification evaluation using illustrative and genomics examples.
main_findings: MCC incorporates all four confusion-matrix categories; the examined examples show how accuracy and F1 alone can give misleading impressions under imbalance.
limitations: Selected-page review only: PDF p.1, Abstract. Text extracted and page visually checked on 2026-10-07.
Published article; PMC open-access copy, CC BY 4.0.
Transfer to cardiac WSI MIL requires qualification.
does_not_establish: Does not establish MCC as a measure of clinical utility, a universally sufficient metric, or a winning SMC model.
relevance_to_project: Report MCC alongside F1, class-specific errors and ranking metrics.
